open_questions: Does a `manifests` config replace the default root-manifest list or add to it? The plan's config comment says 'default: every release manifest at the repo root', which reads as replace; its Evidence row 'the same in crates/jsonvet-cli/pyproject.toml when configured' could mean add. Fixture assumes REPLACE: root Cargo.toml is then not read, so no file holds a version and NOT_CHECKED version appears. Under ADD the second case would also report NOT_SUBSET Cargo.toml keywords and have no NOT_CHECKED.
